objectives.name: time_growth
objectives.semantics: The exact rational g(B_T) in rules.md for the total-work envelope in claim 0. Establish all three original resource statements, scores and any structured bounds for the same algorithm/configuration jointly. Only time is a numeric objective; both memory guarantees remain mandatory. Equal time scores do not imply equal guarantees.

scoring.instructions: Apply rules.md. Establish every original claim exactly as written, including all three full resource statements, nonnegative rational growth indices and every declared structured object. All three bounds must hold jointly for the same algorithm/configuration. Return scores:null; after atomic acceptance derive only time_growth from claim 0. Missing memory claims or an unsupported stronger guarantee cannot be accepted.

validity.instructions: Apply rules.md to unconditional full-secret correctness and jointly charged worst-case resources. Every submission, including partial/unscored or validity-only work, must contain all three supported structured resource bounds with exact nonnegative indices. Missing, malformed or unsupported declarations are format rejection, not unscored acceptance. Format admission does not prove a claim: establish all exact statements and declared structured objects for the same algorithm/configuration, domain, model and evidence. Never infer coefficients or normalization from prose or hints. Reject mathematical mismatches.
